_about: Public-domain Evan H. Hopkins (1837-1918), vicar of Holy Trinity, Richmond, and a founder of the Keswick Convention, for the Word Hoard: Thoughts on Life and Godliness (1878, with his essay The Law of Liberty) and The Walk that Pleases God (sixth edition, 1895), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ehhopkins-thoughts-life: Thoughts on Life and Godliness (London: Hodder & Stoughton, 1878)
ehhopkins-walk-pleases-god: The Walk that Pleases God, sixth edition (London: Marshall Brothers, 1895)
